evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a fresh machine. Only Claude CLI is installed (which claude returns /usr/local/bin/claude). No ~/.golems/config.json exists. The user's workspace root is ~/Projects. The user declines all opt-in features. Simulate the tool detection output from the fixture file.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects only Claude is installed, asks for workspace root, asks about opt-in features (all default OFF), writes a minimal ~/.golems/config.json with tools.claude and reposPath, then offers to install skills via golems-cli.

assertions.name: detects-claude-only
assertions.description: Agent runs which/detection for all 5 CLIs (claude, cursor, gemini, codex, kiro-cli) and correctly identifies only Claude as installed

assertions.name: asks-workspace-root
assertions.description: Agent asks the user for their workspace root directory before writing config

assertions.name: asks-opt-in-features
assertions.description: Agent asks about opt-in features (proactive nudges, night shift, telegram notifications) with all defaulting to OFF

assertions.name: writes-minimal-config
assertions.description: Agent writes ~/.golems/config.json containing reposPath and tools.claude path, with all features disabled

assertions.name: offers-skill-install
assertions.description: Agent offers to install recommended skills via golems-cli after config is written

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a machine with multiple AI CLIs installed. Claude is at /usr/local/bin/claude, Cursor at /usr/local/bin/cursor, Gemini at /opt/homebrew/bin/gemini. No ~/.golems/config.json exists. The user's workspace root is ~/Gits. The user enables proactive nudges but declines other features. Simulate detection from the fixture file.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects all three CLIs, asks for workspace root, presents opt-in features with defaults OFF, user enables nudges only. Writes full config.json with all detected tools and features.proactiveNudges: true. Offers skill installation.

assertions.name: detects-all-three-clis
assertions.description: Agent correctly identifies Claude, Cursor, and Gemini as installed with their paths, and Codex and Kiro as not found

assertions.name: asks-workspace-root
assertions.description: Agent asks for workspace root and accepts ~/Gits

assertions.name: presents-features-with-defaults-off
assertions.description: Agent lists opt-in features with all defaults shown as OFF/disabled, making it clear these are opt-in

assertions.name: writes-full-config
assertions.description: Agent writes config.json with all 3 detected tools, reposPath, and features.proactiveNudges set to true while other features remain false

assertions.name: offers-skill-install
assertions.description: Agent offers to install skills after config is written, mentioning golems-cli

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a machine that already has ~/.golems/config.json with reposPath: ~/Gits and tools.claude: /usr/local/bin/claude. The existing config also has features.proactiveNudges: true. Simulate from the fixture file.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects existing config.json, displays current configuration to the user, and offers two choices: reconfigure (re-run wizard from scratch) or skip (keep current config). Does NOT overwrite without asking.

assertions.name: detects-existing-config
assertions.description: Agent checks for ~/.golems/config.json and finds it exists before proceeding

assertions.name: displays-current-config
assertions.description: Agent shows the user their current configuration (reposPath, tools, features) so they know what's already set up

assertions.name: offers-reconfigure-or-skip
assertions.description: Agent offers clear choice: reconfigure from scratch OR skip and keep current settings

assertions.name: does-not-overwrite-silently
assertions.description: Agent does NOT overwrite or modify the existing config.json without explicit user consent

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a fresh machine. The user provides an invalid workspace path /nonexistent/path/projects that does not exist on disk. Simulate from the fixture file.
evals.expected_output: Agent validates the workspace path, detects it does not exist, informs the user the path is invalid, and re-asks for a valid workspace root. Does NOT write config with an invalid path.

assertions.name: validates-workspace-path
assertions.description: Agent checks that the provided workspace path exists on disk before accepting it

assertions.name: reports-invalid-path
assertions.description: Agent clearly tells the user the path does not exist or is not a valid directory

assertions.name: re-asks-for-valid-path
assertions.description: Agent asks the user to provide a different, valid workspace path instead of proceeding with the invalid one

assertions.name: does-not-write-invalid-config
assertions.description: Agent does NOT write config.json with an invalid/nonexistent reposPath

evals.prompt: Run /wizard after config is written. The user wants to install the 'coach' skill but it is already installed at ~/.claude/commands/coach/. Golems-cli is available. Simulate from the fixture file.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects the skill is already installed, informs the user, and offers to update it (re-download latest version) or skip. Does NOT duplicate the installation.

assertions.name: checks-skill-existence
assertions.description: Agent checks if the requested skill already exists at ~/.claude/commands/coach/ before attempting install

assertions.name: reports-already-installed
assertions.description: Agent informs the user the skill is already installed with its current location

assertions.name: offers-update-or-skip
assertions.description: Agent offers to update the skill to the latest version OR skip the installation

assertions.name: does-not-duplicate-install
assertions.description: Agent does NOT install a second copy or overwrite without consent
